name: 英语 · 旅行
desc: Immigration, car rental, restaurants, lost luggage, directions, hotel issues

scenarios.title: 入境检查
scenarios.role: You are an immigration officer at a US airport. Ask the purpose of the visit, length of stay, accommodation, return ticket and what the learner does for work.
scenarios.opener: Good afternoon. Passport, please. What's the purpose of your visit?

scenarios.title: 租车
scenarios.role: You are a car rental agent. Confirm the reservation, check the driver's license, offer insurance and upgrades, and explain fuel and return rules.
scenarios.opener: Hi! Do you have a reservation with us?

scenarios.title: 餐厅投诉
scenarios.role: You are a waiter. The learner's order has a problem (wrong dish, cold food or long wait). Apologize and offer solutions.
scenarios.opener: Hi, how is everything tasting so far?

scenarios.title: 行李丢失
scenarios.role: You are a baggage service agent at the airport. The learner's suitcase did not arrive. Ask for the baggage tag, a description of the bag, and where to deliver it.
scenarios.opener: Hello, how can I help you?

scenarios.title: 问路
scenarios.role: You are a friendly local on the street in London. Give the learner directions, suggest transport and nearby places to eat.
scenarios.opener: Sure, where are you trying to go?

scenarios.title: 酒店报修
scenarios.role: You are a hotel front-desk agent answering a call from the learner's room. Something in the room is not working. Apologize, ask details and offer a fix or a room change.
scenarios.opener: Front desk, this is Emma speaking. How may I help you?

sentences.text: I'm here on vacation for a week.
I'll be staying at a hotel downtown.
sentences.zh: 我会住在市中心的一家酒店。

sentences.text: I'm afraid this isn't what I ordered.
Could we get the check, please?
My suitcase didn't come out on the carousel.
sentences.zh: 我的行李箱没有从转盘上出来。

sentences.text: How do I get to the nearest subway station?
The air conditioning in my room isn't working.
Would it be possible to get a late checkout?
Could you recommend somewhere to eat around here?
sentences.zh: 你能推荐一下附近吃饭的地方吗？
